figures.note_on_holding_company_metrics: CRITICAL CAVEAT: margins and 'revenue' here are a holding-company accounting artifact (investment income/dividends received, not operating sales), not comparable to an operating company like Atlas Copco or Volvo - do not read the 80%+ margins as operational excellence. Likewise P/E (4.62) is a poor substitute for the metric that actually matters for an investment company - NAV discount/premium to its underlying holdings' market value - which Yahoo does not report and was not obtained this session. Score treat with lower confidence than the other three companies for exactly this reason.
